description: In a countable first-order language, \(\theta\) is independent of \(T\) exactly when both \(T\cup\{\theta\}\) and \(T\cup\{\neg\theta\}\) have nonempty models.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.LargerModels.independent_iff_two_models.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [Countable L.Symbols]
  {T : L.Theory} (θ : L.Sentence) :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.LargerModels.Independent T θ ↔
    (insert θ T).IsSatisfiable ∧ (insert (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.not θ) T).IsSatisfiable
